captions.caption: Title card: "Waterspout Comes Onshore! Key Largo, Florida June 4th, 2012".
Title card remains on screen with video credit.
Title card remains on screen with video credit.
Title card remains on screen with website URL.

Title card remains on screen with website URL.
A dark, cloudy sky is seen over a bay with several wooden docks.
A thin funnel cloud begins to extend downward from the dark clouds.
The funnel cloud becomes more visible against the grey sky.
The camera captures the developing waterspout over the open water.
The waterspout is seen in the distance between the docks and the horizon.
The funnel cloud continues to descend towards the water's surface.
The view shows the waterspout forming under a large, dark cloud formation.
The camera holds steady on the thin funnel cloud in the distance.
The waterspout is a slender column connecting the clouds to the water.
The camera starts to zoom in on the waterspout.
A close-up view shows the condensation funnel high in the sky.
The camera pans down to show the spray at the base of the waterspout.
The base of the waterspout is visible as it churns the water.
The camera pans left to show a person on a small raft in the bay.
A man on a paddleboard is seen in the water as the waterspout approaches.
The waterspout is visible in the background, moving towards the shore.
The man on the raft paddles quickly as the wind starts to increase.
The waterspout kicks up a white spray on the surface of the water.
The waterspout moves closer to the docks and the moored boats.
The man on the raft continues to move towards the safety of the dock.
The waterspout is now clearly visible as a swirling column of spray.
The wind picks up significantly, causing whitecaps on the water.
The waterspout approaches a large boat moored near the dock.
The camera captures the intense spray as the waterspout nears the shoreline.
The man on the raft reaches the side of the wooden dock.
The waterspout's circulation is visible just offshore from the dock.
The spray from the waterspout begins to blow onto the dock.
The waterspout's vortex is now very close to the thatched-roof gazebo.
Strong winds and spray hit the camera as the waterspout passes.
The camera pans to follow the waterspout as it moves onto the land.
The waterspout crosses over the dock, kicking up debris and water.
The man on the raft holds onto the dock as the wind whips around him.
The waterspout's base moves onto the shore, passing near a palm tree.
Intense wind gusts bend the palm tree and rattle the gazebo.
The waterspout continues to move inland, appearing as a small tornado.
Debris is seen flying through the air as the vortex moves past.
The camera captures the waterspout moving through a parking area.
Visibility is poor as rain and spray are blown by the high winds.
The palm trees are seen swaying violently in the strong wind.
The waterspout's path is marked by a swirling cloud of debris and spray.
The camera pans to keep the moving vortex in the frame.
The waterspout moves past a white boat on a trailer on the shore.
The wind continues to howl as the waterspout moves further inland.
The vortex is seen moving behind some buildings and trees.
The intense spray starts to clear as the waterspout's center moves away.
A palm tree continues to whip around in the wake of the storm.
The camera follows the receding waterspout as it moves away from the shore.
The waterspout is visible in the distance over the land.
The wind speed begins to decrease slightly at the camera's location.
The camera pans back towards the bay, showing the rough water.
The person on the raft is seen safely at the dock.
The dark clouds remain overhead, but the immediate danger has passed.
The camera captures the palm trees still swaying in the wind.
The view shows the shoreline after the waterspout has moved inland.
